questions.solution:
• The Giant Tortoise has a lifespan of around 190 to 200 years, making it the longest-living animal.

• Blue Whale: Largest animal but not the longest-living.

• African Bush Elephant: Largest land animal but has an average lifespan of about 60 - 70 years.

• Chimpanzee: Known for intelligence but has a lifespan of around 50 - 60 years.

questions.question: Which country has the highest population density? किस देश का जनसंख्या घनत्व सबसे अधिक है?
questions.solution:
• Singapore has the highest population density among the given options.

• India: Largest population but not the highest in density.

• China: 2nd Largest population but spread over a large area.

• Vatican City: Smallest country but not the most densely populated.

• The Dan Yang-Kunshan Grand Bridge in China is the longest railway bridge in the world.(164.8 km).

• Bogibeel Bridge is the longest rail-cum-road bridge of India on the Brahmaputra River in Assam.(4.94 Km)

• In Russia, Amur River Bridge (also known as the Khabarovsk Bridge) is the longest bridge of Russia approx 2.59 Km

• In Japan, Seto Ohashi Bridge is the longest approx 13.1 Kilometer

• Lake Volta in Ghana is the world's largest artificial lake.

• Caspian Sea: Largest saltwater lake but not artificial.

• Lake Superior: Largest freshwater lake.

• Lake Baikal: Deepest lake.

questions.question: The world's largest diamond is named: विश्व के सबसे बड़े हीरे का नाम है:
questions.solution:
• The Cullinan is the largest diamond ever found, weighing over 3,106 carats (largest rough diamond ever found).Cut into 9 major stones. The Cullinan I is the largest clear-cut diamond in the world.

• Koh-i-Noor:Mined in India (Golconda region). Weight: 105.6 carats (current size after recutting).

• Hope Diamond Mined in India (Golconda region). 45.52 carats (current size). Currently located in the Smithsonian National Museum of Natural History, Washington D.C.

• Orloff Diamond, Mined in India (Golconda region)., weight 189.62 Cararts. Current Location is Diamond fund of the Moscow Kremlin

questions.question: Which country has the longest continuous border in the world? किस देश की सीमा विश्व में सबसे लम्बी है?
questions.solution:
• Canada has the longest continuous land border with US 8,893 Kilometer

• China has the longest land border in the world at 22,475 kilometers. It shares this border with 14 countries.

• Russia has second longest continuous border with Kazakhstan

• Indian has fifth longest land border in the world with Bangladesh

questions.question: The world's longest and deepest rail tunnel is: विश्व की सबसे लम्बी और गहरी रेल सुरंग है:
questions.solution:
• Gotthard Base Tunnel in Switzerland is the world's longest and deepest rail tunnel.

• Laerdal Tunnel: Longest road tunnel.

• Channel Tunnel: Connects the UK and France

• Seikan Tunnel is deep tunnel.

questions.question: Which is the world's largest peninsula? विश्व का सबसे बड़ा प्रायद्वीप कौन सा है?
questions.solution:
• The Arabian Peninsula is the largest in the world.

○ Arabian Peninsula: Located in the Middle East, encompassing countries like Saudi Arabia, Yemen, and the United Arab Emirates.

• Indian Peninsula: Primarily covers the southern part of India, bordered by the Arabian Sea and Bay of Bengal.

• Labrador Peninsula: Found in eastern Canada, bordering Hudson Bay.

• Scandinavian Peninsula: Covers most of Norway, Sweden, and a part of Finland in Northern Europe

• La Paz, the capital of Bolivia, is the highest capital city in the world, situated at about 3,650 meters above sea level.

• Kathmandu, capital of Nepal, is high but not the highest.

• Lhasa is a high-altitude city in Tibet about 3650 meters above sea level but not a capital.

• Thimphu is the capital of Bhutan but lower in altitude than La Paz

questions.question: Which is the largest island in the world? विश्व का सबसे बड़ा द्वीप कौन सा है?
questions.solution:
• Greenland, also known as Kalaalllit Nunaat, is the world's largest island.

• Australia is a continent, not an island.

• Madagascar is the fourth largest island.

• Borneo is the third largest island.

questions.question: The world's longest river is: विश्व की सबसे लम्बी नदी कौन सी है:
questions.solution:
• The Nile River (6,690 km) is the world's longest river.

• The Amazon is the second longest (6,570 km) but carries the most water.

• Yangtze is the longest river in Asia.

• Mississippi is the longest river in North America.

questions.question: Which is the largest coral formation in the world? विश्व का सबसे बड़ा प्रवाल समूह कौन सा है?
questions.solution:
• The Great Barrier Reef in Australia is the world's largest coral reef system, stretching over 2,300 km.

• The Andaman Coral Reef is significant but not the largest. The Andaman Islands have a rich diversity of coral, including soft corals like Sarcophyton sp., Lobophytum sp., and Sinularia sp.

• The Red Sea Coral Reef is one of the longest. Some notable reefs in the Red Sea include al-Shaqa'eq, al-Bahm, and al-Balad.

• Coral reefs are the dominant ecosystems found in the islands of Maldives. The coral reef systems of the Maldives are the seventh largest in the world

questions.question: The driest place on Earth is: पृथ्वी पर सबसे शुष्क स्थान है:
questions.solution:
• The Atacama Desert in Chile is the driest non-polar desert in the world.

• The Sahara Desert is the largest hot desert but not the driest.

• Gobi Desert is in Mongolia.

• Death Valley is one of the hottest places but not the driest.

questions.question: Which is the coldest place on Earth? पृथ्वी पर सबसे ठंडा स्थान कौन सा है?
questions.solution:
• The coldest place on Earth is East Antarctica, specifically the Antarctic Plateau.

• The lowest natural temperature ever directly recorded on Earth was -128.6°F (-89.2°C) at the Soviet Vostok Station on July 21, 1983.

• More recent satellite measurements have identified even colder temperatures in some areas, with pockets reaching as low as -144°F (-98°C) during the polar winter.

• Oymyakon is the coldest inhabited place on Earth located in Siberia, Russia ( -67.7°C / -89.9°F (1933).)

• Verkhoyansk also located in Siberia Russia(Recorded as low as -67.8°C / -90.0°F (1892))

• Greenland Ice Sheet is one of the coldest region in the northern Hemisphere (-66°C / -87°F in winter.)

• The Andes Mountains in South America are the longest mountain range, stretching 7,000 km.

• Himalayas are the highest but not the longest. It 3rd longest mountain range in the world(Approximately 2,400 km)

• Rockies (Rocky Mountains) 2nd longest mountain range in the world approximately 4,800 Km

• Alps located in Europe spans 8 countries (France, Switzerland, Italy, Germany, Austria, Slovenia, Monaco, and Liechtenstein. (Approximately 1200 Km)

questions.question: Which ocean is the deepest in the world? विश्व का सबसे गहरा महासागर कौन सा है?
questions.solution:
• The Pacific Ocean is the deepest, with the Mariana Trench reaching 10,994 meters (36,070 ft).

• The Atlantic Ocean is the second deepest.

• The Indian Ocean is the third deepest.

• The Arctic Ocean is the shallowest.

questions.question: The world's largest active volcano is: विश्व का सबसे बड़ा सक्रिय ज्वालामुखी है:
questions.solution:
• Mauna Loa in Hawaii, USA is the largest active volcano.

• Mount Everest in Nepal is not a volcano, it's the world's highest mountain.

• Mount Fuji located in Japan, it's an active volcano but dormant since 1707

• Krakatoa is an active volcano located in Sunda Strait, Indonesia

• Antarctica is the largest desert in the world, covering approximately 14 million square kilometers. The Sahara is the largest hot desert, covering about 9.2 million square kilometers.

• Antarctica is classified as a cold desert because it receives very little precipitation (less than 50 mm annually, mostly in the form of snow).

• The Atacama Desert in South America is widely recognized as the driest non-polar desert in the world, with some areas receiving virtually no rainfall for decades. The Gobi Desert, while dry, is not as dry as the Atacama.

• The Amazon River does not form a large delta because of the strong Atlantic Ocean currents and the enormous volume of water that flushes sediments into the deep ocean, preventing delta formation

• The Ganga-Brahmaputra Delta, also known as the Sundarbans Delta, is indeed the largest delta in the world. It spans across India and Bangladesh and covers approximately 105,000 square kilometers.

• The second-largest delta in the world is the Lena Delta in Russia, followed by the Mississippi Delta.
